macmoss.creator: Mac Moss / KEEN
macmoss.changes: Only the selected top-right 2×2 cells of the 4×5 sheet. Source timeline sampled at 12 fps (125 vector frames); two tonal contour layers; contour simplification and 255-step cell coordinates (maximum 0.59 source pixel coordinate error). Micrograin, frame and labels are independently rebuilt. No GIF/image/pixel-mask payload is embedded or displayed at runtime.

vercel.creator: Vercel
vercel.changes: Selected dark silhouette/halo material, independently painted from geometric paths and gradients. Halo movement and pointer response approximate light changes; no exact archived animation or original rendering algorithm is claimed. Whole website and current light revision are omitted.

raster.creator: Liubomyr Ulytskyi
raster.target: Selected white rasterized head/bust, two red bars, large rotated 0039 and peripheral microtype/HUD. This does not recreate the current live full-body subject.

geometry.title: Infinite, 3D Head Scan
geometry.author: Lee Perry-Smith
geometry.changes: Centered/scaled, signed16 position and signed8 unit-normal quantization. All 9,279 source vertices and 17,684 triangles retained. Independently authored ordered raster/scanline material and camera motion replace photographic material. Documented head/bust stand-in, not verified as Liubomyr's subject or mesh.

raster.otherChanges: Substitute font and microtype, independently generated background dots, approximate camera/scan motion; no full site scroll, figure-tearing behavior or source JavaScript reproduced.

mecha.assetLicense: Unverified; no independent authorship or reusable-license claim
mecha.changes: Actual primary mark primitive 0 centered/normalized and transformed from its source node. 696 vertices, 1,364 nondegenerate triangles; 24 degenerate faces removed after six-decimal normalization. Derived crease/silhouette edges, independent projection and hidden-line approximation. Timed playback approximates the observed scroll turn; no whole-page scroll behavior or original source JavaScript copied.

origin.creator: Origin Studio
origin.changes: Independent procedural approximation of the changing blurred white dot/teardrop/flares inside the source's small black tile. Three changing blurred radial-gradient light forms; no original media, exact renderer or input coupling claimed. Native full-hero framing is a separate counterpart.
